title: feat(rest, client): a tenant-admin REST door for the record-currency code backfill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DVR4GMtAuGamfk3RpvPfBRN)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyrhYJgbkZHbbqud3F

Fixes #30675

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a new route `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes` (behind `metadata.endpoints.maintenance`), a new SDK method `client.meta.migrateRecordCurrencyCodes`, and two type exports on the `@objectstack/objectql` entry (`RecordCurrencyBackfillOrganization`, `RecordCurrencyBackfillOrganizationsRefusal`).
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: 6675312689 (amended 6675340866, 6675450053) · Branch: `claude/project-thread-1lyw0v` · Ruling-ref: 6670707546 (letter C, item B)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组织管理员没有 shell 也能补币种码了。新增 `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes`，请求体 `{ object, field, code, apply? }`，只补调用者当前组织的无码行；不带 `apply: true` 是预览、不写；SDK 加 `client.meta.migrateRecordCurrencyCodes`。409 `destructive_change` 的补救文字现在同时点名 CLI 和这个门。
- 为什么改：金额字段切到 `currencyMode: 'record'` 后，老行有金额没币种，补救只有 `os migrate record-currency-codes`，云上租户管理员碰不到数据库 shell（裁决 6670707546 C 的 B 项）。
- 风险与回滚：小。新门需要当前组织的 `setup.write`，请求体不收任何组织参数（`organizationId` 等一律 400），无当前组织 403，`maintenance` 开关关掉就不挂载。顺带修了一处泄漏：被沙箱钩子拒写的行，报告里原来是 `hook '<name>' threw:` 调试包装，现在是钩子自己的那句话。回滚即撤 PR。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/meta-record-currency-backfill-route.ts`（门禁顺序、组织取自 `ctx.tenantId`、请求体白名单），`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.ts` 的 `rowFailureSentence`，`packages/rest/src/meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts` 新增的 `DATA_DOORS` 一节。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-record-currency-backfill-route.test.ts`，预期 12 条全绿，其中「the other organization's admin sees and writes only its own row」断言 B 组织管理员只碰到 `b1`、A 组织的行一行未动。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/rest`: the door** (`meta-record-currency-backfill-route.ts`, new; registered from `registerMetadataEndpointsInner` beside the object state read)

- `POST {metaPath}/_migrate-record-currency-codes`, on every mount base the `/meta` family is mounted on, behind `metadata.endpoints.maintenance` (the `_migrate-stored` switch). It sits inside the `/meta` umbrella, so an anonymous caller gets the umbrella's 401.
- The order inside the handler:
  1. The gate: `setup.write` in `systemPermissions` (resolved for the current organization), or `isSystem`. Otherwise `403 FORBIDDEN`. This is asked first, before the body or the engine, so a refused caller learns nothing about objects or kernels.
  2. The organization: `ctx.tenantId`. None means `403 FORBIDDEN` ("no current organization … Nothing was read.").
  3. The body: the closed set `{ object, field, code, apply? }`. Any other key is `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming it. `organizationId` and `allOrganizations` get their own sentence ("this door fills the rows of your current organization only"). Blank names and a non-boolean `apply` are refused the same way.
  4. The engine: the request's environment's, through `wiredEngineOrLoud`. `@objectstack/objectql` stays a devDependency and is loaded by a guarded dynamic import. No engine, or no function, means `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`.
  5. `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes(ql, logger, { object, field, code, apply, organizationId })`. The answer is `{ success: true, data: <report> }`, the report the CLI's `--json` prints.
- Errors use only codes already in the registry. A 4xx the backfill declares is answered with its own status and code (`INVALID_FIELD` with `details.fields`, `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` 404); anything else goes to `sendServerFault`.
- Registered in: `REST_ROUTE_LEDGER` (`disposition: 'sdk'`, no `authz` field, because there is no conformance coverage yet), `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` and `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES`, and the `scripts/check-undeclared-dep-imports.mjs` LEDGER (one `optional-runtime-probe` row, seat amendment 6675450053).

**`@objectstack/client`**: `client.meta.migrateRecordCurrencyCodes({ object, field, code, apply? })` returns `unknown` (see Acceptance notes).

**`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: the `currency_mode_to_record` finding of the 409 `destructive_change` now names the route and its body beside the CLI command.

**`@objectstack/objectql`**
- The entry re-exports `RecordCurrencyBackfillOrganization` and `RecordCurrencyBackfillOrganizationsRefusal` (carried item 1 from the #30674 ACCEPT).
- A truncated walk says it is truncated (carried item 2). The report already carried `truncated`. The text no longer prints "✓ Every … nothing to backfill" for rows it never examined. An unscoped run adds that its organization check saw only the rows examined. The CLI prints a `Walk incomplete` warning. REST and CLI answer the same report.
- A failed row's `error` reads a sandboxed hook as the write doors do (`rowFailureSentence`, the import row's rule). A refusal gives the hook's own sentence. A crash, a declared 5xx or the sandbox's own fault gives the `/data` door's withheld sentence. Any other throw keeps its message. The operator's `logger.warn` line keeps the whole text.

**Docs**
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: a truncation paragraph, then "Without shell access, use the route" with the HTTP and SDK forms. It covers the caller's organization only, the refusals, the capability and the switch, and says there is no Setup button yet.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx`: one sentence.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: row 50b and the regenerated register.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-record-currency-backfill-route.test.ts` (new, 12 cases, real `ObjectQL` over an in-memory driver, two organizations):
  - The org A admin's preview counts only A's rows and writes nothing; every walk read carries A's filter.
  - The org B admin sees and writes only `b1`.
  - Apply writes only the caller's codeless rows, never a coded row or another organization's; `isSystem` with a current organization passes the gate and stays in that organization.
  - The refusals: missing `setup.write` gives 403 with the provider never called; no current organization gives 403; `organizationId` or `allOrganizations` in the body gives 400; a malformed body gives 400; a non-record-mode field gives `INVALID_FIELD` with `details.fields`; an unknown object gives 404; no engine gives 501.
  - The `maintenance` switch off unmounts the route and the other switches leave it; the scoped base mounts it.
- `meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts`: the door joins the closed set of `/meta` write doors as a `DATA_DOORS` entry. It is not a `manage_metadata` door: it reaches no protocol method. It has its own cases. Anonymous gets 401. A capability-less caller, a `manage_metadata` holder and `setup.access` alone each get 403. `setup.write` and `isSystem` pass the gate on both bases, reaching 501 with no engine.
- `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`: the door is driven per row (§2 and §6, 12 shapes), with the failure entry as the answer. The harness caller gained `setup.write` and an organization, and its engine double gained `getObject`. The whole file is green.
- The other census rows: the #8497 tripwire (`no-record-echo`), the `objectQLProvider` consumer census (6 → 7 sites, all through `wiredEngineOrLoud`), the query-slot census (0 slots), the docblock floors (7 blocks), and `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` (the maintenance row gates four routes).
- `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-backfill.test.ts`: a walk cut short by `maxRecords` says so, and the new describe "a failed row reads a sandboxed hook as the write doors do" (a refusal, a crash and an own fault, and a plain-throw control).
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.test.ts`: `--org org_a --max-records 2` prints the incomplete-walk warning.
- `packages/client`: the method POSTs the body and unwraps `data`, and `apply` is sent only when true; its return type is pinned as `unknown`.
- `protocol-destructive-currency-mode.test.ts`: the remedy names the route.

## Acceptance notes

- **The maintenance switch's describe(), with `domain:spec` consent.** `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts` (L538–541) said the switch mounts `GET /meta/diagnostics`, `GET /meta/_drafts` and `POST /meta/_migrate-stored`, and did not name this door. Commit `12af728f` adds `POST /meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes` in the sentence's own list shape and nothing else under `packages/spec/src`. It also carries the regenerated `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx` row and `'@objectstack/spec': patch` in the card changeset, under `domain:spec#2`'s consent 6675431663 (mailbox PR #30557). The hunk raises this PR's review to CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER.
- **The SDK method answers `unknown`, not the report type.** Ruling 2C and the seat's amendment keep it untyped like `migrateStored`. An `any` return would red the shrink-only `packages/client/exported-any-returns.json`, so it is `unknown`. Callers who want the type import it from `@objectstack/objectql`.
- **The shared envelope, where `_migrate-stored` answers bare.** The new module is born on `sendOk` / `sendError` / `sendServerFault` (`check:route-envelope` asks new modules for the shared pair). So the report is `data`, and refusals are `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`.
- **No actor on the writes.** The backfill takes no user. Its writes run under `{ isSystem: true, tenantId: <current organization> }` as the CLI's do, so `modified_by` is not the admin's id. The door's gate is the attribution point.
- **A tenancy-disabled object** (no `organization_id`) is refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 by the backfill. Its sentence says to run it without an organization, which is the CLI's form; over REST there is no such form, by design.
- **Commit trailers.** Two local commits were first written with a model-named co-author trailer. They were reworded to the model-free pair before any push, so every pushed commit carries `Co-authored-by: Claude` plus `Claude-Session`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run` (whole package): 557 files, 11089 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client exec vitest run`: 54 files, 703 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run`: 319 files passed (4 skipped); 22480 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/`: 49 files passed (1 skipped); 375 tests passed. The migrate tests live in `integration`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts test/authz-conformance.test.ts` (they read the registrar lists): 70 passed.
- `tsc --noEmit` for rest, client, metadata-protocol and objectql: exit 0.
- Whole-tree `turbo run build` under the verify lock: 119/119 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

The failure-sentence fix was measured as follows. `rowFailureSentence(err, object, message)` was replaced by `message` in `record-currency-backfill.ts`, and `@objectstack/objectql` was rebuilt, because rest resolves it through `dist`. `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts` then gave 12 failed and 613 passed. After restoring the file and rebuilding, it gave 625 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, reconciled with --ran)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 116 families on head `b56a12d6`. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe.

```
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 116 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 116 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 116 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

The first pass, at an earlier head, had one finding: `check:system-context-census` exited 1, because the door's `isSystem` capability bypass was a read no row owned. Row 50b now owns it, and the generated register was rewritten with `--write`.

The second pass had one prerequisite miss: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs` exited 1 with "packages/spec/json-schema is older than packages/spec/src". That is a gitignored local artifact, made stale by preparing the held spec hunk. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:schema`, it exited 0 ("241 generated files in sync"). The CI families outside the derivation are read from the PR's check-runs, not rerun here.

</details>
